Expense_date_cost_check.name: Expense_date_cost_check
Expense_date_cost_check.value: "Expense"."date" IS NOT NULL OR ("Expense"."cost" IS NOT NULL AND "Expense"."cost" = 0)

Expense_live_charge_assignment_check.name: Expense_live_charge_assignment_check
Expense_live_charge_assignment_check.value: "Expense"."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL OR "Expense"."lineKind" = 'principal' OR ("Expense"."projectId" IS NULL AND "Expense"."purchaseId" IS NOT NULL)

Expense_productQuantity_check.name: Expense_productQuantity_check
Expense_productQuantity_check.value: "Expense"."productQuantity" IS NULL OR ("Expense"."productId" IS NOT NULL AND ("Expense"."productQuantity" <> 0 OR ("Expense"."cost" IS NOT NULL AND "Expense"."cost" < 0)))

ExpenseAttribution_expenseId_role_ledger.name: ExpenseAttribution_expenseId_role_ledgerPartyId_key
ExpenseAttribution_expenseId_role_ledger.where: "ExpenseAttribution"."deletedAt" IS NULL AND "ExpenseAttribution"."ledgerPartyId" IS NOT NULL

FinancialTransaction_ledgerTransferId_po.name: FinancialTransaction_ledgerTransferId_positive_evidence_key
FinancialTransaction_ledgerTransferId_po.where: "FinancialTransaction"."deletedAt" IS NULL AND "FinancialTransaction"."ledgerTransferId" IS NOT NULL AND "FinancialTransaction"."amount" > 0

FinancialTransaction_ledgerTransferId_ne.name: FinancialTransaction_ledgerTransferId_negative_evidence_key
FinancialTransaction_ledgerTransferId_ne.where: "FinancialTransaction"."deletedAt" IS NULL AND "FinancialTransaction"."ledgerTransferId" IS NOT NULL AND "FinancialTransaction"."amount" < 0

Image_attachment_idempotency_key.name: Image_attachment_idempotency_key
Image_attachment_idempotency_key.where: "Image"."idempotencyKey" IS NOT NULL AND "Image"."deletedAt" IS NULL

ImageDerivative_ready_metadata_check.name: ImageDerivative_ready_metadata_check
ImageDerivative_ready_metadata_check.value: "ImageDerivative"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("ImageDerivative"."contentType" IS NOT NULL AND "ImageDerivative"."contentType" = 'image/png' AND "ImageDerivative"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "ImageDerivative"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "ImageDerivative"."width" > 0 AND "ImageDerivative"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "ImageDerivative"."height" > 0)

ImageProcessingJob_lease_check.name: ImageProcessingJob_lease_check
ImageProcessingJob_lease_check.value: ("ImageProcessingJob"."state" = 'leased') = ("ImageProcessingJob"."attemptId" IS NOT NULL AND "ImageProcessingJob"."leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL)

ImportRunTarget_exactly_one_target_check.name: ImportRunTarget_exactly_one_target_check
ImportRunTarget_exactly_one_target_check.value: (("ImportRunTarget"."purchaseId" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("ImportRunTarget"."productId" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("ImportRunTarget"."imageId" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

InventoryEntry_ownership_valid.name: InventoryEntry_ownership_valid
InventoryEntry_ownership_valid.value: ("InventoryEntry"."ownershipMode" = 'person' AND "InventoryEntry"."ownerLedgerPartyId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("InventoryEntry"."ownershipMode" IN ('inherit', 'unassigned') AND "InventoryEntry"."ownerLedgerPartyId" IS NULL)

LedgerParty_member_user_key.name: LedgerParty_member_user_key
LedgerParty_member_user_key.where: "LedgerParty"."deletedAt" IS NULL AND "LedgerParty"."userId" IS NOT NULL

LedgerSourceClaim_owner_check.name: LedgerSourceClaim_owner_check
LedgerSourceClaim_owner_check.value: ("LedgerSourceClaim"."expenseId" IS NOT NULL) <> ("LedgerSourceClaim"."ledgerTransferId" IS NOT NULL)

LedgerSourceClaim_reconciliation_check.name: LedgerSourceClaim_reconciliation_check
LedgerSourceClaim_reconciliation_check.value:
abs("LedgerSourceClaim"."targetAmountAtClaim" * 100 - round("LedgerSourceClaim"."targetAmountAtClaim" * 100)) < 0.0000001
          AND abs((("LedgerSourceClaim"."normalizedEvidence"->>'amount')::double precision) * 100 - round((("LedgerSourceClaim"."normalizedEvidence"->>'amount')::double precision) * 100)) < 0.0000001
          AND (("LedgerSourceClaim"."reconciliationDecision" = 'amounts_match'
            AND "LedgerSourceClaim"."reconciliationNote" IS NULL
            AND abs((("LedgerSourceClaim"."normalizedEvidence"->>'amount')::double precision) - "LedgerSourceClaim"."targetAmountAtClaim") < 0.0000001)
          OR ("LedgerSourceClaim"."reconciliationDecision" = 'accept_target_amount'
            AND length(trim("LedgerSourceClaim"."reconciliationNote")) > 0
            AND abs((("LedgerSourceClaim"."normalizedEvidence"->>'amount')::double precision) - "LedgerSourceClaim"."targetAmountAtClaim") >= 0.0000001))

MealFoodEntry_amount_check.name: MealFoodEntry_amount_check
MealFoodEntry_amount_check.value:
"MealFoodEntry"."amount" IS NULL OR COALESCE((
    jsonb_typeof("MealFoodEntry"."amount") = 'object'
    AND "MealFoodEntry"."amount" ? 'value'
    AND "MealFoodEntry"."amount" ? 'unit'
    AND "MealFoodEntry"."amount" - 'value' - 'unit' = '{}'::jsonb
    AND CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof("MealFoodEntry"."amount"->'value') = 'number' THEN
        ("MealFoodEntry"."amount"->>'value')::numeric > 0
        AND ("MealFoodEntry"."amount"->>'value')::numeric < 'Infinity'::numeric
      ELSE false
    END
    AND jsonb_typeof("MealFoodEntry"."amount"->'unit') = 'string'
    AND length(trim("MealFoodEntry"."amount"->>'unit')) > 0
    AND "MealFoodEntry"."amount"->>'unit' = trim("MealFoodEntry"."amount"->>'unit')
  ), false)

MealFoodEntry_source_check.name: MealFoodEntry_source_check
MealFoodEntry_source_check.value: ("MealFoodEntry"."sourceKind" = 'ingredient' AND "MealFoodEntry"."ingredientId" IS NOT NULL AND "MealFoodEntry"."productId" IS NULL AND ("MealFoodEntry"."amount" IS NOT NULL OR "MealFoodEntry"."grams" IS NOT NULL) AND "MealFoodEntry"."name" IS NULL AND "MealFoodEntry"."nutrients" IS NULL) OR ("MealFoodEntry"."sourceKind" = 'product' AND "MealFoodEntry"."ingredientId" IS NULL AND "MealFoodEntry"."productId" IS NOT NULL AND ("MealFoodEntry"."amount" IS NOT NULL OR "MealFoodEntry"."grams" IS NOT NULL) AND "MealFoodEntry"."name" IS NULL AND "MealFoodEntry"."nutrients" IS NULL) OR ("MealFoodEntry"."sourceKind" = 'manual' AND "MealFoodEntry"."ingredientId" IS NULL AND "MealFoodEntry"."productId" IS NULL AND length(trim("MealFoodEntry"."name")) > 0 AND "MealFoodEntry"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "MealFoodEntry"."nutrients" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("MealFoodEntry"."nutrients") = 'object' AND "MealFoodEntry"."nutrients" <> '{}'::jsonb)

MealRecipePortion_amount_check.name: MealRecipePortion_amount_check
MealRecipePortion_amount_check.value:
"MealRecipePortion"."amount" IS NULL OR COALESCE((
    jsonb_typeof("MealRecipePortion"."amount") = 'object'
    AND "MealRecipePortion"."amount" ? 'value'
    AND "MealRecipePortion"."amount" ? 'unit'
    AND "MealRecipePortion"."amount" - 'value' - 'unit' = '{}'::jsonb
    AND CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof("MealRecipePortion"."amount"->'value') = 'number' THEN
        ("MealRecipePortion"."amount"->>'value')::numeric > 0
        AND ("MealRecipePortion"."amount"->>'value')::numeric < 'Infinity'::numeric
      ELSE false
    END
    AND jsonb_typeof("MealRecipePortion"."amount"->'unit') = 'string'
    AND length(trim("MealRecipePortion"."amount"->>'unit')) > 0
    AND "MealRecipePortion"."amount"->>'unit' = trim("MealRecipePortion"."amount"->>'unit')
  ), false)

ProductCategory_feature_live_unique.name: ProductCategory_feature_live_unique
ProductCategory_feature_live_unique.where: "ProductCategory"."deletedAt" IS NULL AND "ProductCategory"."feature" IS NOT NULL

Purchase_vendorId_orderId_key.name: Purchase_vendorId_orderId_key
Purchase_vendorId_orderId_key.where: "Purchase"."orderId" IS NOT NULL AND "Purchase"."deletedAt" IS NULL

Recipe_name_key.name: Recipe_name_key
Recipe_name_key.where: "Recipe"."deletedAt" IS NULL AND "Recipe"."SourceType" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Book' AND "Recipe"."SourceType" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Notion'

StatementRow_worklist_idx.name: StatementRow_worklist_idx
StatementRow_worklist_idx.where: "StatementRow"."deletedAt" IS NULL AND "StatementRow"."disposition" = 'open' AND "StatementRow"."supersededByRowId" IS NULL

StatementRow_disposition_check.name: StatementRow_disposition_check
StatementRow_disposition_check.value:
("StatementRow"."disposition" = 'open' AND "StatementRow"."dispositionReason" IS NULL AND "StatementRow"."dispositionNote" IS NULL)
          OR ("StatementRow"."disposition" = 'ignored' AND "StatementRow"."dispositionReason" IS NOT NULL AND "StatementRow"."dispositionNote" IS NOT NULL)
